summary.text: Pat Moore is a Democrat who has represented District 17 in the Louisiana House of Representatives since 2019, after 12 years on the Ouachita Parish Police Jury and a career with State Farm. She is a candidate on the ballot for Louisiana's 5th Congressional District.

paragraphs.text: Moore grew up in Monroe and graduated from Wossman High School.
She graduated from the College of Business at Northeast Louisiana University, now the University of Louisiana at Monroe.
She built a career with State Farm, from which she is retired, and the Louisiana Illuminator's voter guide describes her professional background as sales and insurance.
She served on the Ouachita Parish Police Jury, representing District F, from 2007 to 2019.
Moore was elected to the Louisiana House of Representatives, District 17, in 2019.
Her committee assignments for 2025-2026 include Administration of Criminal Justice; Municipal, Parochial and Cultural Affairs; and Transportation, Highways and Public Works.

According to her survey, eight bills she wrote have become law, including protections for seniors buying Medicare supplement coverage and the law creating Louisiana's Community Health Worker Workforce Board.
